rollups.text: The user’s plants and plant-care activities: snake plant, whose leaves were dropping while the user watered it every four days (2023-05-21); aloe-type succulent acquired at a farmers’ market about three weeks earlier and watered weekly (2023-05-21); fiddle leaf fig, for which the user considered a humidifier (2023-05-21); peace lily owned for about two years, with repotting planned (2023-05-21); indoor herbs, including plants nearly ready to harvest (2023-05-27); 12 plants in the user’s small home, with a windowsill rearrangement planned to balance sunlight (2023-05-27); and snake-plant cuttings the user hoped to propagate as gifts (2023-05-27). The user chose the Planta app and planned leaf-cutting propagation, letting cut ends dry before potting (2023-05-27).

The user’s music instruments and gear: Yamaha P-125 digital piano (2023-05-30); Taylor GS Mini guitar (2023-05-30); Fender Mustang I V2 amp used for practice with the Taylor GS Mini (2023-05-30). The user considered replacing the piano, with a budget around $1,000 and a preference for a good piano sound for classical and jazz; planned to try the Korg B1 and Roland FP-10. For the guitar, the user planned to try a Fender Acoustic 40 and Fishman Loudbox Mini, considered the AER Compact 60 above budget, and was interested in a compressor pedal. The guitar’s high action had been adjusted by a technician, making it more comfortable to play (2023-05-30).

The user’s reading and personal-development activities: completed five nonfiction self-help books since January 2023 and maintained a reading habit of at least 20 minutes a day for 45 consecutive days by 2023-05-21; expressed interest in practical habit-building strategies and James Clear’s *Atomic Habits*; wanted to add a 5–10-minute review or reflection after reading and sought prompts and formats (2023-05-21).

The user’s outdoor and camping interests: completed a week-long backpacking trip on the John Muir Trail with the user’s brother, camping at remote sites (2023-04); considered another Sierra Nevada trip with remote campsites and possibly solo camping, without confirming a destination or dates (2023-05-27); anticipated high-elevation cold and possible snow, planned to bring a portable stove and fuel, and considered using a water filter based on a positive prior experience (2023-05-27). The user also lived in Tokyo for about six months and was interested in hiking around Tokyo and visiting Nikko overnight to try yuba cuisine (2023-05-23).

The user’s digital-marketing certification decision: after attending best friend Rachel’s master’s graduation ceremony a couple of weeks earlier, the user considered investing in education and personal growth (2023-05-25). The user compared Digital Marketing Institute’s Digital Marketing Certified Associate program with the American Marketing Association’s Certified Digital Marketing Professional program, leaning toward DMI while weighing cost and time. Working full-time, the user could study 5–6 hours weekly, preferred two weekend mornings, and wanted 3–4 months with buffer time. A suggested schedule was 2.5 hours each on Saturday and Sunday mornings and a four-month module/review plan; the user had not confirmed adopting it (2023-05-25).

The user’s morning-routine plans developed from doing light stretching before bed and trying to establish a consistent sleep schedule (2023-05-25). The user wanted to add regular activity without disrupting sleep and considered yoga or Pilates; they planned to start gentle yoga around 7:00 a.m., use Yoga With Adriene on YouTube, and create a simple home practice space, gradually increasing duration and intensity. The user was excited to see how morning yoga might affect well-being and sleep, but no completed practice was reported (2023-05-25).

The user’s sustainable home-decor e-commerce business planning and promotion: the user had worked on the business plan for three months and wanted to project revenue for the next quarter (2023-05-28). The user planned to research industry benchmarks and historical data, considering 15% first-year growth while accounting for competition, marketing, traction, and seasonality. The user had launched a Facebook campaign targeting sustainable-living and home-decor interests and planned to refine targeting and build a website-visitor lookalike audience with Facebook Pixel (2023-05-28). The user tracked expenses in a spreadsheet but was unsure it captured everything and planned to examine expense-management tools; the user also used an unnamed project-management tool and planned workflow improvements. No financial results or completed targeting changes were reported.

The user’s family-photo preservation and storytelling plans: a slideshow made for the user’s grandparents’ anniversary felt special because it combined family stories and quotes with photos from different life stages (date not specified). In preparation for a planned July 2023 birthday brunch for the user’s mother, the user considered making a similar slideshow using photos and family stories and quotes. The user also planned to review old albums with the mother, digitize selected photos carefully, and ask about traditional family dishes, desserts, and their histories as a way to document family recipes (plans recorded by 2023-05-30; completion not reported).

The user’s Polestar primary-driver module design: the service tracks one primary driver per vehicle, identifies the vehicle by VIN and the driver by Polestar ID, receives POMS order events, validates VINs through VISTA and Polestar IDs through the Polestar ID service, and also offers authenticated APIs for changing drivers (2023-05-24). It stores event history for replay and records update system, timestamp, event and actor details, and order identifiers. The discussed overwrite rule allows a POMS update to replace an API update only when the POMS OrderID is new; PreviousOrderID supports comparison with the prior change. The user described a PrimaryDrivers table with VIN as partition key, Timestamp as sort key, and requested a boolean active attribute: false when EndTimestamp is in the past and true otherwise. The implementation status was not established.

The user was nearly finished binge-watching *The Office*, planned to try *The Good Place* at one episode per night, and also said they would start with *Schitt’s Creek* and share an opinion after a few episodes. No later viewing outcome was recorded.

The user’s family and children’s activities: volunteered at a local children’s museum festival helping children make ceramic masks (2023-05-24); planned a paper-plate butterfly craft with the user’s niece and nephew, including pipe-cleaner antennae, textured wings, symmetrical patterns, and a repurposed shoe-box art organizer (2023-05-24); and planned a family gathering with the user’s three sisters, their spouses, and children, favoring a mixed table arrangement, a separate children’s area, crafts, and a treasure hunt to make a lively gathering manageable (2023-05-28). The user values displaying children’s artwork as encouragement for creativity and confidence (2023-05-24).

The user’s environmental and sustainability interests and efforts: sought community involvement focused on plastic-waste reduction and sustainable living (2023-05-23); had been trying for several months to reduce their carbon footprint and switch to eco-friendly products (2023-05-23); reported that switching to eco-friendly laundry detergent improved skin irritation and that choosing cardboard packaging reduced waste (2023-05-23); and asked about low-waste product choices, container disposal, and reducing household food waste, including making vegetable stock from scraps (2023-05-23 to 2023-05-28).
